info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Healthcare Appointments Notes-v5-spec
info.description: This API allows users to access and retrieve notes related to healthcare appointments. It provides a structured way to review information logged during medical visits, crucial for healthcare providers and administrators. Typical consumers include healthcare professionals, administrative staff, and applications managing patient records. This API enhances the interoperability of healthcare systems by enabling efficient access to appointment-related insights, ultimately supporting improved patient care and documentation accuracy.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of notes associated with appointments.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all notes linked to appointments in the system. You can use this information to get more contextual insights about the appointments and improve your scheduling and meeting processes.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving notes associated with appointments. The body should comply with the defined JSON schema, which includes necessary parameters for the operation.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of appointment notes.

message.description: A descriptive message regarding the operation result.

ListHealthcareAppointmentsNotesResponse_.description: Response schema for retrieving appointment notes following a successful GET operation.
